title: Write a 30-second advertisement
description: Create a timed advertising script with hook, demonstration, evidence and closing action.
accomplishes: Create a timed advertising script with hook, demonstration, evidence and closing action. Include visual, dialogue, sound and caption columns. Use only supplied claims and make offer conditions clear.
prompt:
Act as a video director.

Task: Write a 30-second advertisement.

Input context:
- OFFER: [OFFER]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- CONFIRMED CLAIMS: [CONFIRMED CLAIMS]
- CALL TO ACTION: [CALL TO ACTION]

Create a timed advertising script with hook, demonstration, evidence and closing action. Include visual, dialogue, sound and caption columns. Use only supplied claims and make offer conditions clear.

For relevant shots, specify duration, aspect ratio, composition, camera, lighting, sound and dialogue. Verify tool capabilities before assuming support.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Local class advertisement
0–5 seconds: show the task a beginner wants to learn. 5–18: demonstrate one exercise and introduce the programme. 18–25: explain confirmed requirements. 25–30: invite viewers to see available dates. Do not add fake testimonials or guaranteed outcomes. Recording, legal review and performance measurement remain separate steps.
